exports.name: prediction_contrast
exports.r_signature:
x,
  row1,
  row2,
  measure = c("difference", "ratio", "odds_ratio"),
  probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)

exports.name: prediction_uncertainty_decomposition
exports.r_signature:
fit,
  newdata = NULL,
  include_group_effects = FALSE,
  allow_new_levels = FALSE,
  ndraws = 1000L,
  seed = 1L

exports.name: grouped_prediction_check
exports.r_signature:
fit,
  group,
  ndraws = 1000L,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975),
  seed = 1L

governance_invariants: Prediction contrasts retain R one-based row identifiers.
Contrasts and exceedance probabilities never make automatic decisions.
Prediction uncertainty is a descriptive posterior Monte Carlo decomposition, not a causal variance decomposition.
Grouped posterior-predictive checks never exclude groups automatically.
Predictive residuals are descriptive model checks and do not establish model adequacy.
Posterior interval summaries retain the frozen R default quantile convention (type 7).
No unrestricted backend, likelihood, formula, prior, or decision arguments are exposed.
